paragraphs: When used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K"), the terms "Altria," "we," "us" and "our" refer to either (i) Altria Group, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries or (ii) Altria Group, Inc. only and not its consolidated subsidiaries, as appropriate in the context.

We have a leading portfolio of tobacco products for U.S. tobacco consumers age 21+. We are Moving Beyond SmokingTM, by responsibly transitioning adult smokers to a smoke-free future, competing vigorously for existing smoke-free adult nicotine consumers and exploring new growth opportunities - beyond the United States and beyond nicotine ("Vision").

Our wholly owned subsidiaries include Philip Morris USA Inc. ("PM USA"), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes; John Middleton Co. ("Middleton"), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine-made large cigars and is a wholly owned subsidiary of PM USA; UST LLC ("UST"), which, through its wholly owned subsidiary U.S. Smokeless Tobacco Company LLC ("USSTC"), is engaged in the manufacture and sale of moist smokeless tobacco ("MST") products; Helix Innovations LLC ("Helix") and its foreign affiliates ("Helix International"), which are engaged in the manufacture and sale of oral nicotine pouches; and NJOY, LLC ("NJOY"), which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of e-vapor products. We operate primarily within the United States and generate substantially all of our revenue from domestic customers. Other wholly owned subsidiaries include Altria Group Distribution Company ("AGDC"), which provides domestic sales and distribution services to our operating companies, and Altria Client Services LLC ("ALCS"), which provides various support services to our companies in areas such as legal, regulatory, research and product development, consumer engagement, finance, human resources and external affairs.

At December 31, 2025, we owned a 75% economic interest in Horizon Innovations LLC ("Horizon"), a joint venture with JTI (US) Holding, Inc. ("JTIUH"), a subsidiary of Japan Tobacco Inc. ("Japan Tobacco"), which owned the remaining 25% economic interest. Horizon is responsible for the U.S. marketing and commercialization of heated tobacco stick ("HTS") products owned by either party.

At December 31, 2025, our reportable segments were smokeable products, oral tobacco products and e-vapor products. Our all other category included (i) Horizon; (ii) Helix International; and (iii) other business activities, which primarily consists of research and development ("R&D") expense related to certain new product platforms and technologies. For further information, see Note 15. Segment Reporting to our consolidated financial statements in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Form 10-K ("Item 8").
Our investments include Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV ("ABI") and Cronos Group Inc. ("Cronos"), which we account for under the equity method of accounting using a one-quarter lag.

Portions of the information relating to this Item are included in Operating Results by Business Segment in Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of this Form 10-K ("Item 7").
Our operating companies include PM USA, Middleton, USSTC, Helix and NJOY.

The products of our operating companies include: (i) smokeable tobacco products, consisting of combustible cigarettes manufactured and sold by PM USA and machine-made large cigars manufactured and sold by Middleton; (ii) oral tobacco products, consisting of MST products manufactured and sold by USSTC and oral nicotine pouches manufactured and sold by Helix; and (iii) e-vapor products manufactured and sold by NJOY.

▪Cigarettes: PM USA is the largest cigarette company in the United States and substantially all cigarettes are manufactured and sold to customers in the United States. Marlboro, the principal cigarette brand of PM USA, has been the largest-selling cigarette brand in the United States for over 50 years. Total smokeable products segment's cigarettes shipment volume in the United States was 61.8 billion units in 2025, a decrease of 10.0% from 2024.

▪Cigars: Middleton is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine-made large cigars. Middleton contracts with a third-party importer to supply substantially all of its cigars and sells substantially all of its cigars to customers in the United States. Black & Mild is the principal cigar brand of Middleton. Total smokeable products segment's cigars shipment volume was approximately 1.8 billion units in 2025, an increase of 1.8% from 2024.

▪Oral tobacco products: USSTC is the leading producer and marketer of MST products. The oral tobacco products segment includes the premium brands, Copenhagen and Skoal, and a value brand, Red Seal, sold by USSTC. In addition, the oral tobacco products segment includes on! oral nicotine pouches sold by Helix. Substantially all of the oral tobacco products are manufactured and sold to customers in the United States. Total oral tobacco products segment's shipment volume was 732.4 million units in 2025, a decrease of 5.5% from 2024.

▪E-Vapor products: NJOY contracts with third-party importers to supply all of its products and sells its e-vapor products to customers in the United States. NJOY's product portfolio of tobacco and menthol e-vapor products is covered by marketing granted orders ("MGO") from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA"). NJOY ACE, the principal e-vapor product of NJOY, is subject to an exclusion order and cease-and-desist orders issued by the U.S. International Trade Commission ("ITC") prohibiting the importation and sale of NJOY ACE in the United States, as further discussed in Note 18. Contingencies to our consolidated financial statements in Item 8 ("Note 18").

▪Other tobacco products: In connection with the joint venture agreement with JTIUH, Horizon will market and commercialize HTS products, which are defined in the joint venture agreement as products that include both (i) a tobacco heating device intended to heat the consumable without combusting and (ii) a consumable that meets the definition of a cigarette under the U.S. Federal Cigarette Labeling and Advertising Act. Horizon is responsible for the U.S. commercialization of current and future HTS products owned by either party and, upon authorization by the FDA, will become the exclusive entity through which the parties market and commercialize HTS products in the United States. Upon FDA authorization of Ploom HTS products, JTIUH will supply Ploom HTS devices and PM USA will manufacture Marlboro HTS consumables for U.S. commercialization. As of February 25, 2026, there are no products in the U.S. marketplace from the joint venture.

We elaborate on these important factors and the risks we face throughout this Form 10-K, particularly in the "Executive Summary" and "Business Environment" sections preceding our discussion of the operating results of our segments in Item 7. We may be unsuccessful in anticipating and responding to changes in adult nicotine consumer purchase behavior, including as a result of difficult economic conditions, and preferences, each of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, cash flows or financial position.

Our operating companies' portfolios of nicotine products are largely comprised of premium brands, such as Marlboro, Copenhagen and Skoal. The willingness of adult nicotine consumers to purchase premium brands is affected by macroeconomic conditions, including inflation and overall economic stability. In periods of economic uncertainty and high inflation, we have observed that adult nicotine consumers reduce consumption, purchase more discount brands and consider lower-priced nicotine products, increasing the market share of competitive discount products.

If our operating companies are unable to take actions to mitigate the effects of inflationary pressures and other factors that contribute to their products' industry volume decline rates, it could negatively impact our business, results of operations, cash flows or financial position. For example, due to inflationary pressures and other adverse macroeconomic factors, our operating companies may be unable to sufficiently increase the prices of their premium products to offset volume declines from consumers down-trading to lower-priced competitive brands or moving across nicotine product categories. This inability to increase product prices could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, cash flows or financial position and our ability to achieve our Vision.

Our wholly owned subsidiaries include leading manufacturers of both combustible and smoke-free products. In combustibles, we own PM USA, the most profitable U.S. cigarette manufacturer, and Middleton, a leading U.S. cigar manufacturer.

In smoke-free products, we own USSTC, the leading global MST manufacturer, Helix, a leading manufacturer of oral nicotine pouches, and NJOY, an e-vapor manufacturer with products covered by MGOs from the FDA. Additionally, we have a majority-owned joint venture, Horizon, for the U.S. marketing and commercialization of HTS products.

The brand portfolios of our operating companies include Marlboro, Black & Mild, Copenhagen, Skoal, on! and NJOY. Trademarks related to Altria referenced in this Form 10-K are the property of Altria or our subsidiaries or are used with permission.
Our investments in equity securities include ABI, the world's largest brewer, and Cronos, a leading Canadian cannabinoid company.
For a description of Altria, see Item 1. Business of this Form 10-K ("Item 1"). Vision and 2028 Goals
As we execute on our Vision, we established our 2028 Enterprise Goals ("2028 Goals") to provide our investors with specific metrics to measure our progress. Our 2028 Goals are:

▪Deliver a mid-single digits adjusted diluted EPS compounded annual growth rate ("CAGR") in 2028 from a $4.87 base in 2022, which has been recast as described in Non-GAAP Financial Measures below (for our progress through 2025, see Consolidated Results of Operations);
▪A progressive dividend goal targeting mid-single digits dividend per share growth annually through 2028;
▪Target a debt-to-Consolidated EBITDA ratio of approximately 2.0x (see Liquidity and Capital Resources);
▪Maintain our leadership position in the U.S. tobacco space; and
▪Maintain a total adjusted OCI margin of at least 60% in each year through 2028 (see Operating Results by Business Segment).

本公司營運公司的產品包括：(i) 可吸煙的煙草產品，包含由 PM USA 製造並銷售的可燃式香煙，以及由 Middleton 製造並銷售的機械製大型雪茄；(ii) 口腔煙草產品，包含由 USSTC 製造並銷售的 MST 產品，以及由 Helix 製造並銷售的口腔尼古丁口香包；以及 (iii) 電子煙產品，由 NJOY 製造並銷售。
▪香煙：PM USA 是美國最大的香煙公司，且幾乎所有香煙均由其製造並銷售給美國客戶。Marlboro 是 PM USA 的主要香煙品牌，已連續超過 50 年為美國銷售最多的香煙品牌。2025 年美國可吸煙產品分部的香煙出貨量為 61.8 億支，較 2024 年減少 10.0%。
▪雪茄：Middleton 從事機械製大型雪茄的製造與銷售。Middleton 與第三方進口商簽訂契約，以供應其幾乎所有雪茄，並將其幾乎所有雪茄銷售給美國客戶。Black & Mild 是 Middleton 的主要雪茄品牌。2025 年可吸煙產品分部的雪茄出貨量約為 1.8 億支，較 2024 年增加 1.8%。
▪口腔煙草產品：USSTC 是 MST 產品的主要製造與行銷者。口腔煙草產品分部包含高階品牌 Copenhagen 和 Skoal，以及由 USSTC 士售的價值品牌 Red Seal。此外，口腔煙草產品分部包含由 Helix 士售的口腔尼古丁口香包。幾乎所有口腔煙草產品均由其製造並銷售給美國客戶。2025 年口腔煙草產品分部的出貨量為 732.4 萬支，較 2024 年減少 5.5%。

▪電子煙產品：NJOY 與第三方進口商簽訂契約，以供應其所有產品，並將其電子煙產品銷售給美國客戶。NJOY 的煙草及薄荷電子煙產品組合已獲得美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）的行銷授權訂單（"MGO"）覆蓋。NJOY ACE 是 NJOY 的主要電子煙產品，根據美國國際貿易委員會（"ITC"）頒發的排除令及停止並禁止銷售令，禁止將 NJOY ACE 進口及銷售至美國，如後述於第 8 項（"附註 18"）的 Contingencies 對本公司合併財務報表的影響。

▪其他煙草產品：根據與 JTIUH 的合資協議，Horizon 將行銷與商業化 HTS 產品，該產品在合資協議中定義為包含 (i) 一種煙草加熱裝置，用以加熱消耗品而不燃燒，以及 (ii) 一種符合美國聯邦香煙標籤與廣告法中香煙定義的消耗品。Horizon 負責美國現有及未來 HTS 產品的商業化，經 FDA 批准後，將成為雙方在美國行銷與商業化 HTS 產品的獨家實體。經 FDA 批准 Ploom HTS 產品後，JTIUH 將供應 Ploom HTS 裝置，PM USA 將製造 Marlboro HTS 消耗品以進行美國商業化。截至 2026 年 2 月 25 日，合資協議中尚無產品在美國市場販售。

paragraphs: 本公司擁有美國21歲以上煙草消費者領先的煙草產品組合。我們透過負責任地將成人煙民轉型至無煙未來，實現Moving Beyond SmokingTM，積極爭取現有無煙成人尼古丁消費者，並探索超越美國與尼古丁的成長機會。
本公司全資子公司包括兼具燃燒型與無煙產品的領導製造商。在燃燒型產品方面，本公司擁有PM USA，為美國最獲利的香菸製造商，以及Middleton，為美國領導的雪茄製造商。
在無煙產品方面，本公司擁有USSTC，為全球領導的MST製造商，Helix，為領導的口嚼尼古丁產品製造商，以及NJOY，為電子煙製造商，其產品已獲得FDA的MGOs認證。此外，本公司還擁有美國HTS產品行銷與商業化之主要股權合資企業Horizon。
本公司營運公司的品牌組合包括Marlboro、Black & Mild、Copenhagen、Skoal、on! 以及NJOY。本文件10-K中提及的與Altria相關商標，為Altria或其子公司所有，或經許可使用。
本公司在權益證券的投資包括ABI，為全球最大啤酒商，以及Cronos，為加拿大領導的 cannabinoids 公司。
有關Altria之說明，請參閱本文件10-K之「第1項業務（Item 1）」（「Vision and 2028 Goals」）。
隨著我們落實Vision，我們設定了2028企業目標（「2028 Goals」），以提供投資者具體指標來衡量我們的進展。我們的2028目標為：
▪於2028年，實現調整後稀釋每股盈餘（adjusted diluted EPS）年複合成長率（CAGR）為中位數單位數，以2022年的$4.87為基準，該基準已如Non-GAAP財務指標所述重新計算（有關2025年進展，請參閱合併營運成果）；
▪設定進步的股息目標，每年追求中位數單位數的每股股息成長，至2028年為止;
▪目標將負債與合併後EBITDA比率維持在約2.0倍（詳見流動性及資本資源）;
▪維持本公司在美國煙草產業的領導地位；以及
▪每年維持總調整後OCI邊際率至少60%至2028年（詳見各業務部門營運成果）。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
煙草、其他原材料或零組件的價格、可得性或品質出現重大變動，可能對我們的獲利能力及業務產生重大不利影響。
我們的營運公司可能決定或被要求召回產品，這可能對我們的業務、聲譽、營運結果、現金流或財務狀況產生重大不利影響。

與氣候變遷及其他環境永續事項相關的法律及監管要求，可能對我們的業務及營運結果產生重大不利影響。

我們在企業責任事項方面的表現以及投資者與相關利害關係人對此的反應，可能影響我們的聲譽、吸引投資者的能力以及我們股票的市場價值。

paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性，這些風險與不確定性難以預測，可能對實際結果產生重大影響，且往往超出本公司控制範圍。我們在下文中列舉了部分風險與不確定性。請您仔細閱讀下列風險因素，以評估本公司業務及本10-K表格中所含之預測性陳述。

本10-K表格包含有關本公司預期、計畫、目標、未來財務表現及其他非歷史事實之陳述。您可透過本公司使用如 "strategy"（策略）、"expects"（預期）、"continues"（持續）、"plans"（計畫）、"anticipates"（預期）、"believes"（相信）、"will"（將）、"estimates"（估計）、"forecasts"（預測）、"intends"（意圖）、"projects"（預測）、"goals"（目標）、"objectives"（目標）、"guidance"（指引）、"targets"（目標）及其他相似含義之詞語，來辨識這些預測性陳述。您也可透過這些陳述與歷史或現狀事實無直接關聯之特性來辨識。

本公司無法保證任何預測性陳述將會實現，儘管本公司認為我們在計畫、估計與假設方面已謹慎行事。未來結果之實現仍受風險、不確定性與假設之影響，這些因素可能證明為不正確。若風險或不確定性實現，或基礎估計與假設證明為不正確，實際結果可能與預期有重大差異。您在評估預測性陳述及是否投資或繼續持有本公司證券時，應記取此點。根據1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案之「安全港」條款，本公司已識別出若干重要因素，這些因素個別或整體而言，可能導致實際結果與成果，包括本公司達成願景之能力，與本10-K表格中所含或暗示之預測性陳述有重大差異。我們在本10-K表格中詳細說明這些重要因素與我們所面臨之風險，特別是在「執行摘要」與「業務環境」部分，於我們討論各應報告分部之營運結果前之「項目7」中。您應瞭解，無法預測或識別所有因素與風險。因此，您不應將上述清單視為完整。本公司不承諾更新任何預測性陳述，除非法律有明確規定。
本公司可能無法預見並回應成人尼古丁消費者購買行為之變化，包括因經濟條件困難所致之影響，以及偏好改變，這些都可能對本公司業務、營運結果、現金流或財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
本公司營運公司之尼古丁產品組合主要由高階品牌組成，例如 Marlboro、Copenhagen 與 Skoal。成人尼古丁消費者購買高階品牌的意願受總體經濟條件影響，包括通貨膨脹與整體經濟穩定性。在經濟不確定與高通貨膨脹時期，我們觀察到成人尼古丁消費者減少消費，轉而購買折扣品牌，並考慮較低價格之尼古丁產品，增加競爭性折扣產品之市場佔有率。

若本公司營運公司無法採取行動緩解通貨膨脹壓力及其他導致其產品產業體積下降率之因素，可能對本公司業務、營運結果、現金流或財務狀況產生負面影響。例如，由於通貨膨脹壓力及其他不利總體經濟因素，本公司營運公司可能無法足夠提高其高階產品之價格，以彌補消費者轉向較低價格競爭品牌或跨尼古丁產品類別之體積下降。此無法提高產品價格之情況可能對本公司業務、營運結果、現金流或財務狀況產生重大不利影響，並影響本公司達成願景之能力。
